description: Close one of the bot's own polls early and finalize the results. Voting stops for good, since a poll cannot be reopened. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token ends the poll. A poll that has already closed is left alone.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.

message_id.description: Message ID, or the message's link.

name: end_poll
title: End poll
